verdict.rationale: Sentry's code mappings documentation states that mappings link stack trace paths to source code paths in your repository, enabling source context, suspect commits, stack trace linking and code owners. Separate first-party pages on Suspect Commits, Ownership Rules and Associate Commits back up the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that stack-frame links resolve to the exact line on the default branch, a detailed description of the repo provider integration (e.g., GitHub/GitLab connection setup), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
